purpose: Acceptance contract for HE-001: evidence-earned controls, tool/MCP trust inventory, and quiet-success/actionable-failure hook conformance.
sourceRequest: Implement the approved P1 provenance lifecycle, P1/P2 MCP and tool trust inventory, and P2 hook-output conformance improvements.

criteria.criterion: Load-bearing standing controls carry machine-validated provenance from a production incident, repeated independent signals, or hard external constraint, plus assumption, expected behavior, enforcement, verification, review date, and retirement condition.
criteria.source: Approved P1 recommendation and Addy Osmani Harness Engineering ratchet principle, adapted to ITD signal thresholds.
criteria.evidence: Closed-schema registry and mutation tests reject unearned, stale, unverifiable, or non-retirable controls.

criteria.criterion: A bounded initial set of load-bearing hooks is covered by reversible ablation metadata without claiming blanket coverage or creating a second state plane.
criteria.evidence: Ablation contract cross-links provenance, disable controls, fixed benchmarks, cost/noise observations, and human retirement authority.

criteria.criterion: Tool and MCP entries declare provider provenance, version/digest posture, prompt-text trust, permissions, network and data scope, review status, fallback, and allow/ask/abstain disposition.
criteria.source: Approved P1/P2 MCP and tool supply-chain recommendation.
criteria.evidence: Template schema/validator and positive/mutation fixtures; unknown or unreviewed prompt-bearing providers cannot be silently allow-listed.

criteria.criterion: Adoption and AI-agent security review explicitly inspect installed tool/MCP trust inventory without auto-installing, auto-updating, or creating external writes.
criteria.evidence: Skill contract tests bind the inventory to /adopt and MEM controls in /security-audit.

criteria.criterion: Registered hooks obey a common output contract: clean/no-op success is silent; blocking or advisory failures contain bounded actionable WHY and FIX information with rate-limit/dedup posture.
criteria.evidence: Host-neutral contract plus behavioral meta-tests over the selected hook pilot, including positive and negative fixtures.

criteria.criterion: Harness Engineering documentation maps the Addy Osmani source honestly, distinguishes existing coverage from the new deltas, and does not inflate conformance claims.
criteria.evidence: Documentation freshness, host-adapter parity, meta-review, and quick regression remain green.
criteria.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_host_adapters.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/meta_review.py && bash tests/run-all.sh --quick

doneRule: HE-001 is complete only when every criterion is passed and a current medium-risk Verification Loop adjudication re-runs the named oracle on the exact staged candidate, consumes a targeted fresh-session checker report, and passes receipt revalidation.
